payload.title: Spike: home-page language redirect and hreflang on a preview stack
payload.description: Prototype the viewer-request branch for '/' in amplify/publication/redirect-and-index.js: explicit choice by '?lang=xx' sets the papyrus_lang cookie and redirects to the clean URL; cookie next; then Accept-Language matched to public languages; no header or no match means no redirect. Redirects are 302 with Cache-Control private, no-store and Vary Accept-Language, Cookie; page cache keys unchanged. Test with CloudFront function test tooling and a preview stack deployed through the pipeline (nothing by hand). Validate hreflang and x-default output with a search engine's testing tools. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450).
